scope: All 35 residual whole-token vsagda occurrences in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Normalize vsagda to the official edition form vsegda, joining 155 already-canonical occurrences.
motivation: The official dictionary headword is vsegda/vsegdy and its comparator profile crosses East, West, and South Slavic. The residual vsagda layer was source-clustered spelling variation with no semantic distinction and made the reader internally inconsistent.
alternatives_rejected: Retain vsagda as a South-Slavic variant; the edition needs one stable lemma, and the official cross-family headword is vsegda.
Replace the family with vždy, uvijek, or another branch-specific word; that would exchange one source-shaped layer for another.
